target: Steam Big Picture (Steam client, October 2026 build), home, scaled to 1920x1080
sources: Workstation capture 2026-11-11: Big Picture in a 2567x1603 window (16:10), measured from a crop of the window only and converted to Steam Deck layout units (1280x800; the window is 2.005x), then scaled by height to 1080 lines (x1.35); the capture was deleted after measuring
